create_adaptive_mask: create an AdaptiveMask module with max_size, ramp_size, and init_val to softly mask tensor inputs
apply_adaptive_mask_forward: apply the AdaptiveMask forward pass to mask out the last K values of a tensor gradually
create_adaptive_span: create an AdaptiveSpan module that learns attention span length per self-attention head in a Transformer
mask_attention_with_adaptive_span: mask Transformer attention weights using AdaptiveSpan forward pass with per-head or per-layer adaptive spans
trim_kv_cache_memory: trim key, value, and positional encoding cache tensors using AdaptiveSpan trim_memory to reduce computation
